summary: Frontend-only verification of Phase 9j features: voice vx3 redesign, Image Studio on Studios, Games mobile stacking + desktop two-column layouts (This or That / What's Next), Magic Markup element selection, Music Manager mobile grab bar, Lyric Studio desktop Preview tab removal, Profile desktop centered window + collapsible badges, and Supabase username availability on /_sbtest.html. Most features pass. Two issues found: (1) HIGH – voice mode switching (speaking/thinking) does not re-render the orb class or status text when _voiceMode changes + voiceRender() is called; orb class stays 'is-listening' and status stays 'Listening'. (2) HIGH – Magic Markup deep element selection does not initialize: after window.mkStart() on Library the mk-deep-button is visually pressed (aria-pressed=true, 'is-on' class), the right-side 'EDIT ANY ELEMENT · Tap anything on the page to…' hint is shown, and window.mkdEnable is a function, but window._mkd is null, and clicking a page heading (e.g. the Library hero h1 'Welcome to the Woodz') does not open [data-testid=mkd-panel] or populate [data-testid=mkd-selected]/[data-testid=mkd-breadcrumb]. Toggling the Select button off and on again does not help. All other spec items verified as passing.

ui_bugs.issue: Setting window._voiceMode='speaking' (or 'thinking') and calling window.voiceRender() does NOT update the orb class (stays 'vx-orb press is-listening') or [data-testid=voice-status] text (stays 'Listening'). Spec requires orb class to become is-speaking/is-thinking without the orb re-entering, and status text to update. voiceRender() either ignores _voiceMode or hard-codes 'listening' when rebuilding the HTML. See /app/memory/p9j.js voiceRender / voiceBodyHtml – the orb class and status label need to be derived from window._voiceMode.

ui_bugs.component: Magic Markup deep element selection on Library
ui_bugs.issue: After window.mkStart() on Library, mk-deep-button has aria-pressed='true' and class 'mk-tb-btn is-ic is-on' (visually on by default per spec), and window.mkdEnable exists as a function. However window._mkd is still null, and clicking the hero h1 ('Welcome to the Woodz' at ~x=839,y=197) does NOT create [data-testid=mkd-panel] / [data-testid=mkd-selected] / [data-testid=mkd-breadcrumb]. The 'Tap anything on the page to select it' hint persists. Toggling the Select button off then back on also fails. mkdEnable()/mkdApplyEl() appear not to be wired to pointer events on page start, OR the overlay/section-bar is intercepting clicks before mkdApplyEl runs. See /app/memory/p9h.js mkdEnable and the click handler installation path, and /app/memory/p9j.js mkdEnable + mkSetEdit wrapper.

verified_pass.username_availability_live_sbtest: On /_sbtest.html with seeded __mock_sb_db (profiles.ux.username='taken_name') and sbAuthRender('signup'): [data-testid=sb-auth-username] exists. Typing 'taken_name' -> hint '@taken_name is taken. Try another one'; typing 'fresh_name' -> '@fresh_name is available'; typing 'ab' -> format hint '3–20 letters, numbers, _ or .'. Submitting with taken_name shows [data-testid=sb-auth-msg]='@taken_name is already taken. Try another one.' and sbUser() stays null. Submitting with fresh_name + email + password signs in and state.profile.username === 'fresh_name'.
verified_pass.console_clean: No console errors observed on Library/Studios/Game views at 1920x800 or 390x844 or on /_sbtest.html signup flow.

action_items: HIGH: Fix voice overlay mode switching in /app/memory/p9j.js voiceRender(): orb class and [data-testid=voice-status] text must be derived from window._voiceMode so that setting _voiceMode='speaking' or 'thinking' and calling voiceRender() updates the orb to is-speaking/is-thinking and the status label (e.g. 'Speaking' / 'Thinking') without the orb re-entering.

HIGH: Fix Magic Markup deep element selection initialization. After mkStart() on Library the Select toggle is visually pressed and 'EDIT ANY ELEMENT · Tap anything on the page to…' prompt shows, but window._mkd stays null and clicking page elements does not create [data-testid=mkd-panel]. mkdEnable()/mkdApplyEl() must be wired on mkStart (or when _mkd defaults to on) and must not be blocked by the section-select overlay or 'Magic Markup on' toast. Validate on Library hero h1 ('Welcome to the Woodz').

NICE: Rebuild (python3 /app/memory/patch_p9.py && python3 /app/memory/build_sbtest.py) after fixes and re-run iteration_18 against: voice mode switch, MK deep selection + Style/Move/Size/Text/Reset flow, Image Studio file picker + download, Lyric Studio desktop/mobile Preview-tab visibility.
critical_code_review_comments: voiceRender() in /app/memory/p9j.js appears to rebuild the voiceBodyHtml with a hard-coded 'is-listening' class and 'Listening' label rather than reading window._voiceMode. The orb class and status text need to be computed from the current mode and status map.

In /app/memory/p9h.js the Magic Markup deep handler (mkdEnable/mkdApplyEl) should install a document-level pointerdown/click capture listener that early-returns if deep is off, otherwise computes the target element via document.elementFromPoint (ignoring the section-bar/toast overlays) and builds the breadcrumb + panel. Current behaviour suggests the listener either isn't attached when the toolbar renders with the Select pre-pressed, or is attached only after a manual toggle but still returns early because window._mkd is null when first used.
/_sbtest.html Supabase mock username flow is working correctly end-to-end; keep the sbUnameAvail/unHint interface stable.

success_rate.frontend: ~82% – voice overlay layout/commands/close, Image Studio card, games mobile stacking, games desktop side-by-side + ToT landing/fullscreen (wrapW=1280), What's Next landing, Music Manager mobile grab bar, Profile desktop centered + badges collapsible with persistence, and Supabase username availability (taken/available/invalid + submit error + submit success with profile.username set) all pass; voice mode switch + MK deep selection fail; some flows (Image Studio apply/save, Lyric Studio desktop rail, MK edit panel tabs) could not be fully exercised.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 9j: two HIGH regressions. (1) Voice mode switch broken – window._voiceMode='speaking'/'thinking' + voiceRender() leaves orb class 'is-listening' and status 'Listening' (see /app/memory/p9j.js voiceRender/voiceBodyHtml). (2) Magic Markup deep selection fails to open mkd-panel on click – button is visually pressed by default and 'EDIT ANY ELEMENT · Tap anything on the page to…' hint is shown, window.mkdEnable exists but window._mkd stays null and the Library hero h1 click does nothing (see /app/memory/p9h.js mkdEnable/mkdApplyEl + /app/memory/p9j.js mkdEnable wrapper). Note: build step is python3 /app/memory/patch_p9.py && python3 /app/memory/build_sbtest.py – do not edit /app/single_html/index.html directly. All other spec items verified pass (voice layout+scroll lock+chips+transcript+help+close+theme cmd, Studios Image Studio card, games mobile stacking + desktop side-by-side, ToT fullscreen wrap 1280, Music Manager grab bar in-panel at 390, Profile centered width 1233 w/ margins 347/340, badges collapsible + persisted to treesh_pf_badges_open, Supabase username availability live hints + submit guard + success). Lyric Studio desktop rail could not be exercised because window.SONGS stayed empty for 5s on fresh load – need deterministic SONGS seed or a test hook.
rca of the issue: Voice mode switch: voiceRender() in /app/memory/p9j.js rebuilds the overlay body (voiceBodyHtml) but appears to always set the orb class to 'vx-orb press is-listening' and status label to 'Listening' instead of reading window._voiceMode. Fix: compute orb class suffix and status text from window._voiceMode ('listening'|'speaking'|'thinking') with a lookup table and keep the orb element in-place to preserve the entry animation. Magic Markup deep selection: mkStart on Library primes the Select toolbar button (aria-pressed=true, 'is-on' class) and sets up the 'Tap anything on the page to…' hint, but window._mkd is never initialized to {on:true, …} and the document-level pointer handler that calls mkdApplyEl is not wired on mkStart. Fix in /app/memory/p9h.js: ensure mkdEnable(true) runs at the end of mkStart when deep is default-on and installs a capture-phase click handler on document that calls document.elementFromPoint(x,y) to pick the deepest valid target (excluding .mk-toolbar, .mk-toast, the section-bar); gate return by window._mkd?.on.
